sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Gig work and the price of flexibility
passage.text: Platform work is praised for its flexibility: a driver can start at noon and stop at four. The flexibility is real, but it is not free. Because gig workers are classified as independent contractors, the platform does not contribute to insurance or retirement, and the worker bears the cost of idle time. Surveys find that hourly earnings, once these costs are subtracted, are often below those of comparable salaried jobs. Defenders reply that workers value the freedom to choose hours, and the surveys support this too. The policy question is therefore not whether flexibility is good, but who pays for it. A system that lets workers keep the flexibility while sharing the insurance cost would be both fairer and more stable.

sections.name: 翻译
sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

items.stem: The policy question is therefore not whether flexibility is good, but who pays for it.

answer.text: 因此，政策问题不在于灵活性好不好，而在于由谁来为它买单。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 160 words on the following topic: gig workers enjoy flexible hours but often lack insurance and retirement benefits. Propose a fair arrangement.

answer.text: Platform work offers something salaried jobs rarely do: the freedom to choose when to work. It also transfers hidden costs to the worker. Independent contractors pay for their own insurance and retirement, and they absorb the cost of hours when no work arrives. Surveys that subtract these costs find hourly earnings below those of comparable salaried jobs. Banning platforms would remove the flexibility that workers say they value, so the better route is to separate the two issues. Platforms could contribute to a portable insurance account for every active hour, while workers keep control of their schedules. Flexibility would remain; the risk would be shared.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：只主张「加强监管」或「平台全责」，没有说明如何保留灵活性。

framework.title: 图画作文
steps: 首段：一句点图（As is vividly depicted…），再写 2 句细节
二段：一句点寓意，再展开因果或举例
三段：一句总结 + 一句建议/展望
用具体名词替换万能词（people→students/employees）
framework.trap: 只描述图画不解释寓意，二段空洞
